blocks.c: Edward and Alphonse Elric in 'Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood'.

blocks.x: There are so many essential anime series out there, but the definitive one that has everything all fans want is arguably Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood. However, all they uncover is a plot to consume the entire world if they don't gear up and stop it.

Many people consider Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood to be the greatest anime series of all time, which naturally makes it a 21st-century masterpiece as well. It is an anime that doesn't need a remake because it perfected the manga's story with excellent worldbuilding, lore, character development, plot twists, drama, action, animation, comedy, and moments. Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood is the complete anime package that defines this century.

Naoki Urasawa is one of the most prolific manga authors of all time, and his magnum opus, Monster, is also a 21st-century anime masterpiece. Dr. Tenma decided to save the life of a child instead of the mayor, but years later, that same child is now a serial killer. Tenma takes it into his own hands to kill Johan, but will he be able to pull the trigger when he learns of his dark and tragic past?

Monster is one of the longer shows on this list, but it is 74 episodes of a thriller masterclass that starts as a slow burn but gets hotter the longer it goes on. The dynamic between Tenma and Johan is one of the best, and the latter in particular is regarded as one of the greatest anime villains. Monster knows when to take things slow and when to ramp them up, creating an excellent pace that is unpredictable and thrilling.

blocks.c: Mob smiling while colorful spirits come out in Mob Pyscho 100

blocks.x: The greatest anime masterpiece of the 21st Century isn't so easily decided, but the honor ultimately went to the show that checks all boxes. Mob Psycho 100 follows Shigeo, the world's strongest psychic. If fans want to laugh, Mob Psycho 100 has it covered. If they want to be dazzled by animation, it has them covered. If they want endearing characters, an engaging story, epic action, and emotional moments, it has them covered. Mob Psycho 100 is only around a decade old, yet it is an anime series that has aged like fine wine because of its flawless coalescing of themes, writing, animation, and entertainment value.

Smile and Peco have enjoyed playing table tennis with each other since their youth, but when they decide to join the competitive scene, Smile gets bored because he is way better than everyone, and Peco can't handle the competition.

Ping Pong the Animation is an engrossing story about winning, losing, sports, and dreams, following not just the protagonist, but the struggles, sacrifices, and troubles of the entire cast. The imaginative animation fits well with the magnificent story that features amazing character development. Ping Pong the Animation is a must-watch anime that tells an essential story that is also fun and relatable.

Image via Bones Inc.

There are so many essential anime series out there, but the definitive one that has everything all fans want is arguably Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood. When brothers Edward and Alphonse lose parts or all of their bodies in a taboo alchemical experiment, they set out to find the philosopher's stone. However, all they uncover is a plot to consume the entire world if they don't gear up and stop it.

Many people consider Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood to be the greatest anime series of all time, which naturally makes it a 21st-century masterpiece as well. It is an anime that doesn't need a remake because it perfected the manga's story with excellent worldbuilding, lore, character development, plot twists, drama, action, animation, comedy, and moments. Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood is the complete anime package that defines this century.

2
'Monster' (2004–2005)

Image via Madhouse

Naoki Urasawa is one of the most prolific manga authors of all time, and his magnum opus, Monster, is also a 21st-century anime masterpiece. Dr. Tenma decided to save the life of a child instead of the mayor, but years later, that same child is now a serial killer. Tenma takes it into his own hands to kill Johan, but will he be able to pull the trigger when he learns of his dark and tragic past?

Monster is one of the longer shows on this list, but it is 74 episodes of a thriller masterclass that starts as a slow burn but gets hotter the longer it goes on. The dynamic between Tenma and Johan is one of the best, and the latter in particular is regarded as one of the greatest anime villains. Monster knows when to take things slow and when to ramp them up, creating an excellent pace that is unpredictable and thrilling.

1
'Mob Psycho 100' (2016–2022)

Image via Bones

The greatest anime masterpiece of the 21st Century isn't so easily decided, but the honor ultimately went to the show that checks all boxes. Mob Psycho 100 follows Shigeo, the world's strongest psychic. However, he only wants to have a normal school life, but because he holds his emotions back, his psychic powers explode, making life difficult for him, his friends, and his enemies.

If fans want to laugh, Mob Psycho 100 has it covered. If they want to be dazzled by animation, it has them covered. If they want endearing characters, an engaging story, epic action, and emotional moments, it has them covered. Mob Psycho 100 is only around a decade old, yet it is an anime series that has aged like fine wine because of its flawless coalescing of themes, writing, animation, and entertainment value.
